boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Elmhurst University spaces where students can study, meet, recharge, exercise, eat or join campus activities, verified through current university sources.

cards.title: Settle In Around the Fireplace
cards.subtitle: A flexible Frick Center lounge for work, conversation and meetings
cards.notes: Bring reading or meet a project partner here; the lounge supplies couches, work tables, campus equipment and a view across University Mall.
cards.short_summary: A fireplace lounge that shifts easily between solo work, informal meetings and downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst identifies Founders Lounge as a Frick Center space where students can study, relax, meet friends, attend events and club meetings, and use printers and other amenities.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Frick Center; campus services and hosted events may affect use of the space.

cards.title: Take a Break Below Frick Center
cards.subtitle: Television, games, seating and food in one student hangout
cards.notes: Head to the lower level between commitments for television or a game; check dining hours separately if you also plan to order food.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level recreation space where students can eat, watch television and play tabletop games.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst says students use the Bluejays’ Roost/Game Room to watch television, spend time with friends and eat; its connected game area includes pool and ping-pong.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Frick Center’s lower level; food service follows separate academic-year dining hours.

cards.title: Use the Commuter Base Camp
cards.subtitle: Tables, seating and lockers beside the Bluejays’ Roost
cards.notes: Use the tables for work between classes, then ask at the Frick Center Information Desk if you need a commuter locker for your books.
cards.short_summary: A practical between-class workspace with seating and nearby storage for commuter students.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst describes the Commuter Lounge beside the Bluejays’ Roost as a study and relaxation space with tables and seating, plus lockers for commuter belongings.
cards.access_notes: Located beside the Bluejays’ Roost in the Frick Center; locker arrangements go through the Information Desk.

cards.title: Rehearse Together on a Bigger Screen
cards.subtitle: Reservable rooms for individual and group study
cards.notes: Reserve the room size you need; for collaborative work or presentation practice, ask the Library Services Desk about display cables.
cards.short_summary: Bookable rooms support quiet individual work, group collaboration and presentation run-throughs.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst documents group and single study rooms on different library levels; many group rooms have large displays for collaboration and presentation practice.
cards.source_title: MBA Program Orientation – A.C. Buehler Library
cards.access_notes: Study rooms require reservation or checkout; equipment availability is handled at the Library Services Desk.

cards.title: Pair a Table With a Quick Refill
cards.subtitle: Main-level café seating inside A.C. Buehler Library
cards.notes: Use the café seating to review notes or reconnect with classmates; visit during posted academic-year service hours if you want refreshments.
cards.short_summary: A library-side seating area designed for schoolwork, conversation and optional snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst says the Library Café offers seating where students can relax, spend time with friends and do schoolwork; it serves drinks and snacks on the library’s main level.
cards.access_notes: Located on the main level of A.C. Buehler Library; café service follows posted academic-year hours.

cards.title: Meet Over a Full Meal Window
cards.subtitle: The Mall-level campus café serving three daily meals
cards.notes: Coordinate a group meal here and check the academic-year schedule first; breakfast, lunch and dinner each have separate service windows.
cards.short_summary: A central dining room suited to planned meals and informal meetups between campus commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst places the Frick Center Café on the building’s Mall level and lists breakfast, lunch and dinner service during the academic year.
cards.access_notes: Meal service follows the current academic-year schedule published on the university dining page.

cards.title: Split Your Workout Across Two Floors
cards.subtitle: Student strength and cardiovascular facilities in Faganel Hall
cards.notes: Bring your Jaypass and choose the floor that fits your workout: strength equipment downstairs or cardiovascular equipment upstairs.
cards.short_summary: A two-level student facility separating strength training from cardiovascular exercise.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst states that Tyrrell Fitness Center is available to all Elmhurst students and contains 3,000-square-foot strength and cardiovascular rooms plus locker rooms.
cards.access_notes: Located at 221 Walter Street; a Jaypass is required for entry, and users should consult current hours and policies.

cards.title: Step Away for a Quieter Reset
cards.subtitle: A relaxation room inside the Niebuhr Hall Wellness Center
cards.notes: Use this room when you need to decompress between commitments; contact the Wellness Center before visiting if access details are unclear.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated Wellness Center room for students seeking a brief, low-stimulation pause.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst says the Wellness Center’s Serenity Room lets students relax and de-escalate and includes a full-spectrum light.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Wellness Center on Niebuhr Hall’s lower level; confirm availability with the center before relying on access.

cards.title: Find the Campus Gathering Lawn
cards.subtitle: The central green used for recreation and student events
cards.notes: Check the student-events calendar, or bring classmates outside for informal recreation when the lawn is not reserved for a campus program.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn doubles as open green space and a venue for organized student activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst identifies University Mall as a wide-open campus green and documents student recreation there, including equipment-supported Jays on the Mall activities.
cards.source_title: Tyrrell Fitness Center and Campus Recreation
cards.access_notes: Outdoor use is weather-dependent and may be limited when University events reserve the lawn.

cards.title: Bring the Assignment to Academic Support
cards.subtitle: Library-based tutoring and study assistance for Elmhurst students
cards.notes: Take a specific question or draft to the library-based center, and check its current appointment process before planning a tutoring visit.
cards.short_summary: A shared academic-support destination for tutoring, study strategies and assignment help.
cards.evidence_claim: Elmhurst identifies the Learning Center inside A.C. Buehler Library as an academic-support resource available to all Elmhurst University students.
cards.access_notes: Located in A.C. Buehler Library; confirm current service hours and appointment requirements before visiting.
